theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmbsf_tg_coarea_gluing
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (S : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)) (g : Euclid P → Euclid P) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (φ : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞), MeasurableSet M → (∀ j, MeasurableSet (S j)) → Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (S i) (S j)) → (∀ j, S j ⊆ M) → Measurable g → (∀ x, (∀ j, x ∉ S j) → g x = 0) → Measurable f → (∀ j, AEMeasurable (fun t => ∫⁻ x in S j ∩ {x | g x ≠ 0} ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, φ x ∂ν) ∧ ∫⁻ t, (∫⁻ x in S j ∩ {x | g x ≠ 0} ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, φ x ∂ν) = ∫⁻ x in S j, ‖g x‖ₑ * φ x ∂μ) → AEMeasurable (fun t => ∫⁻ x in M ∩ {x | g x ≠ 0} ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, φ x ∂ν) ∧ ∫⁻ t, (∫⁻ x in M ∩ {x | g x ≠ 0} ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, φ x ∂ν) = ∫⁻ x in M, ‖g x‖ₑ * φ x ∂μ
